items.title: Free Standing Pallet Inverter (1600 mm Jaw Opening)

items.title: V-Cart Industrial Trolley (includes 1 folding basket)
items.description: IMPROVED VERSION, NOW BIGGER, STRONGER AND BETTERCOMES STANDARD WITH 3 YEARS WARRANTY! The V-Cart is a collapsible trolley that can be used for hundreds of applications. It is ideal for use in the workplace, schools, home, offi­ce, hospitals, courier services, shopping malls, nursing homes and much more! It can be completely collapsed by the push of a button on the handle. The wheels are able to be removed by the push of a button and stored underneath for compact transport and storage. The V-Cart is supplied with one collapsible basket which will lock into place on either the top or bottom platform. The top platform can be folded back to allow larger items to be transported if required. Extra baskets are available for use on both platforms or up to 4 baskets can be stacked on the bottom platform. A robust foot pedal brake allows the V-Cart to be locked in position whilst loading or unloading. The injection moulded plastic and aluminium design means that whilst the V-Cart is lightweight it is still very robust and has a great carrying capacity. The basket fits foolscap suspension files - great for transporting documents throughout the office. The V-Cart can also be used with the No.7, No.10. No.15 tubs which you can purchase here (plastic tubs). See sizes and specifications on 'specifications' tab below.

items.title: V-Cart Folding Plastic and Aluminium Trolley (includes 1 folding basket)
items.description: IMPROVED VERSION, NOW BIGGER, STRONGER AND BETTERCOMES STANDARD WITH 3 YEARS WARRANTY! The V-Cart folding trolley is a collapsible trolley that can be used for hundreds of applications. It is ideal for use in the workplace, schools, home, offi­ce, hospitals, courier services, shopping malls, nursing homes and much more! It can be completely collapsed by the push of a button on the handle. The wheels are able to be removed by the push of a button and stored underneath for compact transport and storage. The V-Cart is supplied with one collapsible basket which will lock into place on either the top or bottom platform. The top platform can be folded back to allow larger items to be transported if required. Extra baskets are available for use on both platforms or up to 4 baskets can be stacked on the bottom platform. A robust foot pedal brake allows the V-Cart to be locked in position whilst loading or unloading. The injection moulded plastic and aluminium design means that whilst the V-Cart is lightweight it is still very robust and has a great carrying capacity. The basket fits foolscap suspension files - great for transporting documents throughout the office. The V-Cart folding trolley can also be used with the No.7, No.10. No.15 tubs which you can purchase here (plastic tubs).

The new EZ loader can now handle a wide range of weight capacities from 110 kilos to 1800 kilos. The EZ Adjust knob - a three position knob that allows adjustment of the collapsed capacity without changing the air pressure. The patented pneumatic system found only on the EZ Loader has proven to be the choice of industry professionals worldwide. items.title: Filtration Unit
items.description: The Filtration Unit provides a safe and efficient solution for managing concrete washwater directly onsite. It is specifically engineered to capture and control harmful slurry waste, reducing environmental impact and ensuring compliance. The system incorporates a 300GSM 80 Micron Filtration Bag with a non-woven geotextile inner layer in a 900 mm cube design, reinforced by a protective bulk bag exterior. This bag is capable of separating sand, gravel, and concrete particles as fine as 80 microns from slurry created during washouts of concrete trucks, saw cutting, core drilling, grinding, and grooving. Excess water passes through the filter bag into the collection tank below, where it can be held for testing and treatment. The unit can also operate as a dewatering station for managing sediment-laden water on sites that require strict control over runoff and pollution. Ensures best practice and EPA compliance when managing concrete slurry onsite Designed to manage slurry from concrete truck washouts, equipment cleaning, cutting, coring, and grinding applications Suitable for pumping and filtering sediment from water containing silt 300GSM 80 Micron Filtration Bag designed to filter and separate washout particles from slurry water Filter bag suspended from frame for straightforward removal when full, using a crane or forklift Handles up to 80 truck washouts before the supplied filter bag requires replacement Onsite wastewater testing and treatment possible without sending waste offsite Comes standard with a 50mm valve for efficient use Equipped with fork guides and crane lugs for simple relocation across the site Protected with a durable enamel paint finish Working Load Limit (WLL): 1500kg Sump Capacity: 300L Bag Capacity: 0.6 cu.m Valve Size: 50mm Fork Pocket Size: 342x72mm Fork Pocket Centre: 716mm Load Centre: 382mm HCG: 542mm Overall Dimensions (LxWxH): 1200x1200x1430mm Unit Weight: 140kg

items.title: Tyre Inflation Enclosure
items.description: The Tyre Inflation Enclosure is built to provide a safe environment for inflating tyres, particularly those used on trucks and heavy machinery. Tyre inflation carries significant risks due to the stored energy in pressurised air or gas, the size and weight of assemblies, and the potential for combustible material. In the event of a burst or release, components can be propelled at high speed over long distances. Constructed from heavy-duty steel with a 5-bar design, this enclosure is engineered to protect workers and equipment from the dangers of a tyre blast. Offers personnel protection during tyre inflation Helps reduce the risk of injury and damage from a tyre burst Compatible with tyres up to 1150mm in diameter and 400mm wide Built with heavy-duty construction to resist high force and impact Base locating guides keep wheels stable and correctly positioned Features five 60mm tube bars with closer spacing in the impact zone for added strength Finite Element Analysis verifies the structure can withstand extreme blast forces Material: Steel Finished in enamel paint for durability Maximum Tyre Size (DxW): 1150x400mm Internal Dimensions (WxH): 404x1290mm Overall Dimensions (LxWxH): 950x580x1350mm Unit Weight: 90kg

items.title: Mega Bin Rotator Base
items.description: The Nally MegaBin is the original Australian bulk bin. Designed for fruit and vegetable movement and retail high performance the Nally MegaBin is clearly the way of plastic produce bins in Australia. Rounded corners and smoother interior surfaces results in less bruising and damage to your produce. Multiple vents in sides and base provide superior airflow so products cool faster adding valuable shelf life to your produce. The smooth, non-absorbent surface will not harbour or transfer mould, bacteria or disease carrying organisms. The design is compatible with most bin handling equipment. Bins feature unique moulded label holders for cards and tags. Small, exterior pads reduce scratches. Easy, clear ownership with identification with hot foil stamping. Comfortable handholds are built in for easy lifting and handling of bins. The positive interlocking foot design permits fast and safe stacking. Nally Megabins are up to 40% lighter in weight than wood bins and the weight is constant as they don’t absorb moisture. This allows for Increased freight efficiencies of 4-5%. In practice you are able to transport 2-3 extra bins of fruit per semi-trailer load. Available in both solid and vented Rotator Base with and without wheels available to suit Polypropylene UV stable Standard Pallet Size: 1165mmx1165mm Maximum load capacity: 500kg

items.title: V-Cart Folding Warehouse Trolley (includes 1 folding basket)
items.description: IMPROVED VERSION, NOW BIGGER, STRONGER AND BETTERCOMES STANDARD WITH 3 YEARS WARRANTY! The V-Cart is a collapsible trolley that can be used for hundreds of applications. It is ideal for use in the workplace, schools, home, offi­ce, hospitals, courier services, shopping malls, nursing homes and much more! It can be completely collapsed by the push of a button on the handle. The wheels are able to be removed by the push of a button and stored underneath for compact transport and storage. The V-Cart is supplied with one collapsible basket which will lock into place on either the top or bottom platform. The top platform can be folded back to allow larger items to be transported if required. Extra baskets are available for use on both platforms or up to 4 baskets can be stacked on the bottom platform. A robust foot pedal brake allows the V-Cart to be locked in position whilst loading or unloading. The injection moulded plastic and aluminium design means that whilst the V-Cart is lightweight it is still very robust and has a great carrying capacity. The basket fits foolscap suspension files - great for transporting documents throughout the office. The V-Cart can also be used with the No.7, No.10. No.15 tubs which you can purchase here (plastic tubs). See sizes and specifications on 'specifications' tab below.

items.title: Industrial V-Cart Trolley
items.description: IMPROVED VERSION, NOW BIGGER, STRONGER AND BETTERCOMES STANDARD WITH 3 YEARS WARRANTY! The V-Cart is a collapsible trolley that can be used for hundreds of applications. It is ideal for use in the workplace, schools, home, offi­ce, hospitals, courier services, shopping malls, nursing homes and much more! It can be completely collapsed by the push of a button on the handle. The wheels are able to be removed by the push of a button and stored underneath for compact transport and storage. The V-Cart is supplied with one collapsible basket which will lock into place on either the top or bottom platform. The top platform can be folded back to allow larger items to be transported if required. Extra baskets are available for use on both platforms or up to 4 baskets can be stacked on the bottom platform. A robust foot pedal brake allows the V-Cart to be locked in position whilst loading or unloading. The injection moulded plastic and aluminium design means that whilst the V-Cart is lightweight it is still very robust and has a great carrying capacity. The basket fits foolscap suspension files - great for transporting documents throughout the office. The V-Cart can also be used with the No.7, No.10. items.title: Filtration Unit
items.description: The Filtration Unit provides a safe and efficient solution for managing concrete washwater directly onsite. It is specifically engineered to capture and control harmful slurry waste, reducing environmental impact and ensuring compliance. The system incorporates a 300GSM 80 Micron Filtration Bag with a non-woven geotextile inner layer in a 900 mm cube design, reinforced by a protective bulk bag exterior. This bag is capable of separating sand, gravel, and concrete particles as fine as 80 microns from slurry created during washouts of concrete trucks, saw cutting, core drilling, grinding, and grooving. Excess water passes through the filter bag into the collection tank below, where it can be held for testing and treatment. The unit can also operate as a dewatering station for managing sediment-laden water on sites that require strict control over runoff and pollution. Ensures best practice and EPA compliance when managing concrete slurry onsite Designed to manage slurry from concrete truck washouts, equipment cleaning, cutting, coring, and grinding applications Suitable for pumping and filtering sediment from water containing silt 300GSM 80 Micron Filtration Bag designed to filter and separate washout particles from slurry water Filter bag suspended from frame for straightforward removal when full, using a crane or forklift Handles up to 80 truck washouts before the supplied filter bag requires replacement Onsite wastewater testing and treatment possible without sending waste offsite Comes standard with a 50mm valve for efficient use Equipped with fork guides and crane lugs for simple relocation across the site Protected with a durable enamel paint finish Working Load Limit (WLL): 1500kg Sump Capacity: 300L Bag Capacity: 0.6 cu.m Valve Size: 50mm Fork Pocket Size: 342x72mm Fork Pocket Centre: 716mm Load Centre: 382mm HCG: 542mm Overall Dimensions (LxWxH): 1200x1200x1430mm Unit Weight: 140kg

items.title: Safety Mesh Fence Starter Kit (1000mm High)

items.title: Walk-through Access Platform Ladder - 10 Step
items.description: The Walk-through Access Platform Ladder range is manufactured to Australian Standard AS/NZS 1892.1 and built for safe, stable elevated access in industrial and commercial workplaces. Available in step options from 3 to 12, each model features a walk-through platform design that allows easy entry and exit at height. This helps improve workflow and reduce risk during repetitive tasks. Ideal for warehouses, workshops, mezzanine levels, vehicle access, and stock picking applications. items.title: Heavy Duty Steel Longspan Shelving
items.description: The Verdex Heavy Duty Longspan Shelving is a strong, modular storage system for cartons, archive boxes, parts and other manually handled goods. It offers high-capacity storage in a compact format, with adjustable shelf levels and multiple sizes and configurations available for warehouses, workshops and storerooms. Shelf capacity by beam length: 1200mm beam – 800kg per level 1800mm beam – 390kg per level 2400mm beam – 290kg per level Supplied standard with 3 adjustable shelf levels, with additional shelf levels available Step beams allow the shelf decks to sit flush with the beam, creating an even storage surface Available in 450mm, 600mm and 900mm depths Suitable for cartons, archive boxes, parts and general manually handled stock End frames supplied assembled for quick and easy setup Modular design with clip-in beams requiring no special tools Additional sizes and configurations available on request Allow 60mm per frame when calculating the overall bay length
